rifle.name: Rifle
rifle.description: The standard rifle every soldier carries.

grenade.name: Grenade
grenade.description: Rifle grenades lobbed at troops behind cover.

tank_ap.name: AP Shell
tank_ap.description: Armour-piercing sabot: the tank gun's answer to armour.

tank_he.name: HE Shell
tank_he.description: High-explosive shell for troops, cover and buildings.

hmg.name: HMG
hmg.description: A heavy machine gun for troops and light vehicles.

atgm.name: ATGM
atgm.description: A wire-guided anti-tank missile, steered onto its target.

carbine.name: Carbine
carbine.description: A short rifle for close quarters: handier, less accurate at range.

lmg.name: LMG
lmg.description: A light machine gun: long belts of fire that keep heads down.

marksman_rifle.name: Marksman Rifle
marksman_rifle.description: A designated marksman's scoped rifle: aimed single shots past rifle range.

heavy_sniper.name: Heavy Sniper
heavy_sniper.description: A .50-calibre rifle: few, heavy, long shots.

autocannon.name: Autocannon
autocannon.description: A slow-firing cannon whose small bursting shells tear up troops, cover and light armour.

tow.name: TOW 2A
tow.description: Optically supported direct anti-tank missile; launcher line of sight is required.

kornet.name: Kornet
kornet.description: Optically supported direct anti-tank missile; no top-attack or fire-and-forget behavior.

spike.name: Spike
spike.description: Optically supported direct anti-tank missile; no top-attack or fire-and-forget behavior.

javelin.name: Javelin
javelin.description: Top-attack anti-tank missile: it climbs, then dives onto the roof; the gunner must keep sight.

stinger.name: Stinger
stinger.description: A shoulder-fired missile that reaches only aircraft; the gunner keeps it in his sight.

patriot_pac3.name: PAC-3 MSE
patriot_pac3.description: Long-range missile that also shoots down missiles fired from aircraft.

pantsir_missile.name: 57E6
pantsir_missile.description: Medium-range missile that also shoots down missiles fired from aircraft.

air_bomb.name: Iron bomb
air_bomb.description: Unguided iron bomb with a heavy single blast.

air_bomb_cluster.name: Cluster bombs
air_bomb_cluster.description: Wide-spread cluster bomb salvo for area attacks.

air_ground_missile.name: Air ground missile
air_ground_missile.description: A fast guided anti-armour missile for ground attack.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.description: Optically supported direct anti-tank missile; no top-attack or fire-and-forget behavior.

heli_atgm.name: Air ATGM
heli_atgm.description: A helicopter's anti-tank missile: fired and steered on the move.

rocket_pod.name: Rocket Pod
rocket_pod.description: Unguided rockets in salvos, for troops, light vehicles and cover.

helicopter_crash.name: Crash
helicopter_crash.description: A downed airframe striking the ground: no gun fires it. It fells the trees beneath and hurts what lies there, less than a shell.

rpg_general.name: RPG HE
rpg_general.description: A general-purpose high-explosive rocket for infantry and light armour.

artillery_howitzer.name: Howitzer
artillery_howitzer.description: Indirect-fire howitzer shell for long-range support.

artillery_mortar.name: Mortar
artillery_mortar.description: High-angle mortar bomb for close indirect support.

artillery_rocket_light.name: Rocket salvo
artillery_rocket_light.description: Unguided rocket salvo for deep area fire.

artillery_rocket_heavy.name: Heavy rocket salvo
artillery_rocket_heavy.description: Heavy rocket salvo for deep area fire.

artillery_strike_missile.name: Strike missile
artillery_strike_missile.description: Long-range unguided strike missile for deep area fire.
